messages:
devon-peopleops: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — wanted to collect the travel/desk/offsite Qs in one place. I'll try to answer the easy ones and loop in Anna and Mike for policy/roadmap stuff. /cc @anna-peopleops @mike-cto
anna-peopleops: thanks devon! I'll drop the official policy links below and flag anything that needs follow-up with finance.
jasmin-ops: minor nit — is there a preferred booking tool now? I still have Concur saved, but heard about Expensify pilot?
mike-cto: short answer: for employee travel use Expensify for receipts + Concur for corporate card reconciliation. We're rolling Expensify to everyone next quarter; until then either is fine as long as you tag the project.
jordan-qa: from the Q&A: priority desk assignment for people in travel weeks — can we reserve a desk for the week of the offsite or is it first-come first-served?
anna-peopleops: good q. We have a temporary priority window for offsite weeks: you can place a one-time weekly hold via the workspace app up to 10 days before the event. After that it's open. Rules: 1) one hold per person per offsite, 2) holds expire at midnight of the last day of your offsite.
devon-peopleops: adding the link to the hold flow: https://workplace.internal/desk-holds (internal) — file a hold, choose hub, and include your offsite tag.
travel-bot: Reminder: expense policy v2 uploaded. Docs: https://docs/redwood/finance/expense-policy-v2
yasmin-ops: reimbursement timing question — if I pay for a hotel on my card, how long til I see reimbursement?
anna-peopleops: finance aim is 7 business days after submission with all receipts attached. If you use the corporate card it should auto-match and clear faster. If you hit >10 business days ping finance@redwood.com and we'll escalate.
jordan-qa: are meals covered on travel days? like arrival/departure?
mike-cto: policy covers meals for full travel days. For partial days, reasonable meals are allowed if within our per-diem. We ask teams to keep it reasonable; leadership asked us to avoid blanket exceptions — escalate if you think there's a special case.
devon-peopleops: sample expense tag to use when submitting for an offsite:``` 
project: offsite-<hub>-<year>
reason: all-hands / team-offsite
cost-center: <team-code>
```
anna-peopleops: guest policy: guests are allowed at dedicated offsites with manager sign-off and an approved RSVP list. Guests in working hubs (day-to-day desk use) require manager approval + badge request 72h in advance.
yasmin-ops: what about travel windows — do we have blackout dates for booking lowest fare vs flexible?
mike-cto: no strict blackout for economy fares, but we encourage flexible fares if the event is mission-critical and cancellations are likely. For Dedicated headcount travel (sales/ops) teams have separate approval flows — reach out to your ops lead.
jordan-qa: can we get a short FAQ for engineers about remote-first folks who need a desk for 2 days after returning from travel? Sometimes folks can't get a desk day-of.
anna-peopleops: yes — plan: 48-hour grace hold for returning-from-travel workdays. Use the hold flow and choose "post-travel grace". This is intended for short re-onboarding; not for reserving a permanent desk.
devon-peopleops: quick note on budgets: team leads — please add estimated travel headcount in the project plan (even rough numbers) so finance can pre-allocate. That avoids reimbursement delays.
travel-bot: Tip: attach receipts as PDFs, not photos, if possible — speeds approval.
yasmin-ops: any changes to vaccine/COVID testing requirements for offsites?
mike-cto: no new company-wide mandates. Local hub rules still apply — if a venue requires proof/tests we'll follow them. For international travel, follow the country's entry rules. Team leads should include any extra requirements on the event RSVP.
anna-peopleops: ops checklist for offsite owners: 1) submit travel estimate 30 days out, 2) create desk-holds 10 days out, 3) publish local health/venue rules on the RSVP page, 4) collect guest approvals 7 days out. I'll share a template.
devon-peopleops: planning to send a short follow-up doc after this thread. If people have specific edge cases (e.g., visa reimbursements, long-term remote who need permanent desk during project weeks), drop them here and we'll route to the right owner.
jordan-qa: thanks — one last thing: public transit stipend for certain hubs?
anna-peopleops: yes, hubs with high transit costs have an optional commute stipend for offsite days up to $15/day. See the stipend tab in the HR portal.
devon-peopleops: great thread — thanks everyone. I'll post the concise FAQ + checklist by EOD and ping leadership if anything needs escalation. :thumbsup:
mike-cto: thanks — good follow-up. If leadership needs to clarify roadmap impacts for travel-heavy teams I'll chime in.
travel-bot: Action logged: offsite-policy-followup created (ticket #3456)
